announcements.text: The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory University Affiliated Research Center, Laurel, Maryland, was awarded a $499,800,000 ceiling indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract with cost-plus-fixed-fee term and completion task orders contemplated for engineering, development, and research services capabilities. This contract provides for establishing and maintaining an essential capability for engineering or developmental work calling for the practical application of investigative findings and theories of a scientific or technical nature. Work will be performed primarily in Laurel, Maryland, with an expected ordering completion date of October 2031. No funds are obligated at the time of award; the minimum guaranteed amount will be obligated with the first task order. This contract was a sole source acquisition. The Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency, Arlington, Virginia, is the contracting activity (HR001127DE001).

announcements.text: Lockheed Martin, Rotary and Missions Systems, Liverpool, New York, was awarded a $74,294,440 firm-fixed-price modification to previously-awarded contract N00024-20-C-5503 for production of Surface Electronic Warfare Improvement Program AN/SLQ-32(V)6 systems. This contract combines purchases for the governments of Canada (52%), and Japan (47%) under the Foreign Military Sales program; and the Coast Guard (1%). Work will be performed in Liverpool, New York, (78%); and Lansdale, Pennsylvania (22%), and is expected to be completed by September 2029. Fiscal 2026 Foreign Military Sales (FMS) funds for Canada in the amount of $38,388,165 (52%); fiscal 2026 FMS funds for Japan in the amount of $35,448,507 (47%); and fiscal 2025 procurement, construction, and improvements (Coast Guard) funds in the amount of $457,768 (1%), will be obligated at time of award and will not expire at the end of the current fiscal year. Naval Sea Systems Command, Washington, D.C., is the contracting activity. (Awarded Oct. 9, 2026).

announcements.text: Lockheed Martin Corp., Fort Worth, Texas, is awarded a $16,111,551 firm-fixed-price modification (P00001) to a previously awarded delivery order (N0001926F2222) under a basic ordering agreement (N0001924G0010) for avionics test capabilities, cybersecurity modernization, and specialized repair infrastructure supporting the F-35 Integrated Core Processor. The effort includes associated engineering, program management, planning, readiness reviews, and introduction-to-service activities to sustain fleet operational readiness. Work will be performed in McKinney, Texas (50%); and Palm Bay, Florida (50%), and is expected to be completed in January 2029. Fiscal 2026 aircraft procurement (Air Force) funds in the amount of $8,055,775; and fiscal 2026 aircraft procurement (Navy) funds in the amount of $8,055,776, will be obligated at the time of award. This contract modification was not competitively procured. Naval Air Systems Command, Patuxent River, Maryland, is the contracting activity.
